verdict.rationale: Flagsmith ships an official MCP server that gives AI assistants access to the Admin API. Its docs say "your assistant can manage feature flags, segments, multivariate options, and release workflows on your behalf," so users can drive the product in natural language through an external AI client. There is no evidence of a native natural-language interface in the product itself; the conversational layer comes from a third-party assistant. missing for 10: a built-in natural-language command interface in the dashboard or CLI, hands-on or independent corroboration of NL-driven operation, and documentation of which operations the MCP tools cover and how well.
